hints: Match coefficients with $7\sin\theta+24\cos\theta$, then square and add to find exact $R$.
Use $\tan\alpha=7/24$ with $0<\alpha<\pi/2$, and give $\alpha$ to exactly 4 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Expand $R\cos(\theta - \alpha)$ using the compound angle identity $\cos(A - B) = \cos A\cos B + \sin A\sin B$:
$$R\cos(\theta - \alpha) = (R\cos\alpha)\cos\theta + (R\sin\alpha)\sin\theta$$

Calculate the exact value of $R$ by summing squares:
$$R^2 = (R\cos\alpha)^2 + (R\sin\alpha)^2 = 24^2 + 7^2 = 576 + 49 = 625$$
$$R = \sqrt{625} = 25$$

Find $\tan\alpha$ and evaluate $\alpha$ in radians to 4 decimal places:
$$\tan\alpha = \dfrac{R\sin\alpha}{R\cos\alpha} = \dfrac{7}{24} = 0.2916667$$
$$\alpha = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{7}{24}\right) \approx 0.283794 \dots \approx 0.2838 \text{ radians}$$
$$R = 25, \quad \alpha = 0.2838$$

ai_rubric.R-Form Trigonometry: Solving this equation gives $R=25$ from work. Solving this equation gives $\alpha =0.2838$. The solved value is R=25, α = 0.2838.
